plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ubiquiti airOS wireless device (airMAX and airOS-based airFiber, FROGFOOT-RESOURCES-MIB, enterprise PEN 10002). It reports uptime, CPU load, memory usage, and interface traffic. Not for EdgeSwitch / UniFi switches.
name: Wireless

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: 5-minute CPU load average of the Ubiquiti airOS device, from the 5-minute row (index 2) of FROGFOOT-RESOURCES-MIB loadTable loadValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.10002.1.1.1.4.2.1.3). The value is the load average x100 (e.g. 150 = load 1.5), not a utilization percentage, and can exceed 100 on multi-core devices or when processes are queued. A sustained rise can indicate heavy wireless traffic, many associated stations or abnormal management-plane load.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Ubiquiti airOS device, computed at collection time as (memTotal - memFree) / memTotal * 100 from FROGFOOT-RESOURCES-MIB memTotal and memFree.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total usable physical memory of the Ubiquiti airOS device in bytes (FROGFOOT-RESOURCES-MIB memTotal 1.3.6.1.4.1.10002.1.1.1.1.1.0, KB converted to bytes at collection time).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used physical memory of the Ubiquiti airOS device in bytes, computed at collection time as memTotal - memFree.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Available physical memory of the Ubiquiti airOS device in bytes (FROGFOOT-RESOURCES-MIB memFree 1.3.6.1.4.1.10002.1.1.1.1.2.0, KB converted to bytes at collection time).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
